correctness.rationale: Characteristic-zero proof: coprime Chebyshev derivatives have disjoint simple roots; degree-(a+b−1) Gauss coordinates have no base points and are birational by biduality. Symbolic checks for 73 coprime pairs corroborate but do not prove the unrestricted statement.
